name: DocsGPT
description: Self-hosted AI agents grounded in your documents, sites and connected apps, answering with sources on any model.
whatItDoes: Turns documentation, websites and connected applications into agents that answer questions with citations. Teams use it for internal knowledge assistants and support bots.
howItWorks: Sources are ingested and indexed, then agents and visual workflows retrieve from them and call tools while answering. It runs entirely in your environment with a cloud or local model, and is set up through a one-line install script.

requirements.name: LLM provider
requirements.description: Cloud model key or a local model
